semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential exhaust gas treatment equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hangzhou Huixiang E&H Technology manufactures local scrubbers designed for the semiconductor industry, focusing on treating harmful gases produced during manufacturing processes such as silicon wafer epitaxy and chip manufacturing. Their equipment ensures compliance with environmental regulations and minimizes waste gas residues.
capabilities: Local scrubbers for exhaust gas treatment
Equipment for semiconductor silicon wafer epitaxy
Gas treatment for SiC and MOCVD processes
